headline: ADVENTURE's chase now ends at the doorway
lede: Dragons followed the dot between rooms even when they were on the wrong side of the wall — the seam law followed an anchor band, not the dragon. It now demands what the 2600 hardware enforced: the dragon's sprite rect must genuinely overlap the doorway rect (DRAGON_FOLLOW_SLACK deleted), so the bite and the sword-turn are judged honestly inside the new room, and side-room chases stay on their side of the stone.

notes.text: seamFollow rewritten to exact sprite-rect admission (x 50–100 vertical, y 60–120 side); mirror entry, parallel axis and jaw gate untouched.
adventurecheck 223/0 with 7 new boundary pins + slack-regression mutant; all 60 mutants die; advedrive 10/10 real Chrome, zero page errors; CI static green.
